import numpy as np

xc, yc, th = 0.921, 4.336, np.radians(315.0)
f, H = 256.0, 1.55

# In obs_0040, grey object top/edges:
# u ~ 180 to 260, v ~ 275 to 365
# If bottom was around v=365:
v = 365.0
u = 240.0
Zc = f * H / (v - 256.0)
Xc = (u - 256.0) * H / (v - 256.0)
Xw = xc + Xc * np.cos(th) + Zc * np.sin(th)
Yw = yc - Xc * np.sin(th) + Zc * np.cos(th)
print(f"Grey object bottom at v=365: ({Xw:.3f}, {Yw:.3f})")

# If bottom touches floor further back, say v ~ 320:
v = 320.0
Zc = f * H / (v - 256.0)
Xc = (u - 256.0) * H / (v - 256.0)
Xw = xc + Xc * np.cos(th) + Zc * np.sin(th)
Yw = yc - Xc * np.sin(th) + Zc * np.cos(th)
print(f"Grey object at v=320: ({Xw:.3f}, {Yw:.3f})")
'
